integrity: The stationary-current formula of Ngo Phuoc Nguyen Ngoc, Lam Thi Nhung, and Huynh Anh Thi (arXiv:2606.01568v1) is credited as the essential input. The new contribution is exact global optimization and its singular asymptotic classification.
scientific_limitations: The optimized flux is the published thermodynamic active-sector current; no finite-size spectral claim or new invariant measure is asserted. Rate limits are limits of the thermodynamic expression at strictly positive rates.
title: Unique optimal density and cube-root strong-recovery saturation in the tandem exclusion process
